title: Ahotoso a Edi Kan a Wɔabubu wɔ Paradise
intro: Fa no sɛ wugyina turo bi a asomdwoe a edi mũ wom mu, a wɔahyɛ no anuonyam sen abɔde nyinaa, a ɔhye biako pɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ wobu no. Asɛm a ɛyɛ sereserew hyɛ daa ho bɔ, paw biako sesa biribiara, na nanso mmɔborohunu bue ɔkwan a wɔfa so san kɔ akyi. Hena na ɔkasa fi adesamma mfiase?
clues: Allah na ɔbɔɔ me firii dɔteɛ mu na ɔde ɔsoro ahwɛyie na ɛyɛɛ me.
Wodii me animuonyam berɛ a Allah hyɛɛ abɔfoɔ no sɛ wɔnkotow mma me.
Me ne me hokafo traa Paradise, na na mewɔ ahofadi sɛ minya ne nyinaa mu anigye gye dua biako pɛ.
Satan a ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔfotufo a ofi komam no nsɛm a ɔkae no daadaa me.
Midii dua a wɔabara no na woyii m’akataso no fii hɔ wɔ aniwu mu.
Mesuaa adwensakyera nsem firii m’Awurade hɔ, na Allah danee ne ho baa me nkyɛn wɔ mmɔborɔhunu mu.

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
